# graphiant_content_filter (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant global content filter by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_content_filter" "block_social_media" {
  id = 12345
}

output "block_social_media_rule_count" {
  value = length(data.graphiant_content_filter.block_social_media.rules)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Content filter identifier.

### Read-Only

- `lan_names` (List of String)
- `name` (String) Content filter name.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Domain-category blocking rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `site_list_id` (Number)
- `use_all_sites` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `domain_category_id` (Number)
- `exception_wildcards` (List of String)
